resources.string: Official stable and preview releases
AstrBot update channel

Stable releases are selected by default. Including previews enables Alpha, Beta and RC releases, which may change data formats. Updates are backed up and roll back on failure. Switching back to stable does not downgrade the installed program.
Offline source and Dashboard ZIPs for the same version, a complete archive, or a signed maintenance package
Select one signed maintenance package, or official source and Dashboard ZIP files for the same version (at most two, one of each type).
Unsupported update archive. Select official Source code (zip), the matching AstrBot dashboard.zip, or a signed maintenance package; APKs, backups and TAR.GZ files are not supported here.
This ZIP contains only web resources. Also select Source code (zip) for the same version, or a complete update package. Offline imports do not download missing files.
This source archive lacks complete web resources. Also select the Dashboard ZIP for the same version, or a complete update package. Offline imports do not download missing files.
The staged files changed or are incomplete. Import the package again; the installed program is unchanged.
Checking local archives and matching versions…
Local offline import

Uses the selected local files without comparing them with official content online. Program, dashboard and runtime compatibility are checked before backing up and updating. Failed startup validation rolls back the update.
The ZIPs are different versions: %1$s and %2$s. Select the program and dashboard for the same version. Your previous selection is kept.

Install AstrBot update
Follow the message above, or check the logs for the step that failed.
The AstrBot settings file could not be read, or its dashboard section is invalid. Restore a backup or check data/cmd_config.json in the terminal. Existing settings are kept.
The dashboard enabled setting is invalid. Set dashboard.enable to true or false in the AstrBot settings file and retry.
The dashboard listen address is unsupported. Set dashboard.host to 127.0.0.1 (phone only) or 0.0.0.0 (LAN access), then retry.
The dashboard port is invalid. Set dashboard.port to an integer from 1024 to 65535 (default 6185), then retry.

Back up and install
Installation pauses AstrBot, backs up your data, then starts the new version to verify it. If verification fails, the previous program and data are restored.
